findings.title: yaml.load without SafeLoader (unsafe deserialization)
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one critical security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: app.py:9
Issue: yaml.load without SafeLoader (unsafe deserialization) (CWE-502, A08:2025)
What to change: Use yaml.safe_load() (or Loader=yaml.SafeLoader). yaml.load can execute arbitrary objects.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "d5a7dc6a9658".

findings.title: Flask debug mode enabled (app.run(debug=True))
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one warning security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: app.py:14
Issue: Flask debug mode enabled (app.run(debug=True)) (CWE-489, A02:2025)
What to change: Never run with debug=True in production — it exposes the Werkzeug debugger (RCE) and stack traces.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "6eb3e0594f9a".
